verdict.rationale: HubSpot docs describe concrete API endpoints (e.g., POST to /crm/v3/objects/contacts) and a developer docs site, suggesting some interactive/code-sample reference exists, but probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or machine-readable docs endpoints (all 404), and no direct evidence of a runnable/interactive API console like Swagger UI or Postman-style try-it-now.
